I took it for a spin and it does everything I asked for. I pasted a link and it pulled in the title, description, and icon on its own; saving with just a URL worked and my own edits stuck. Trying to save the same link again stopped me and pointed me back to the one I already had. Search behaves the way I wanted — I could pull up a tag with `#recipes`, exclude things with NOT, and a broken query gave me a clear "add a tag name" message instead of odd results. Tag suggestions offered up what I'd already used. Favorites and my "still to read" list stayed separate — flipping one didn't disturb the other — and just opening a link left it unread until I said otherwise. Editing and deleting both worked, with delete asking first.

This is what I set out to build, and it holds up. I'm happy to accept it as the first version.
